cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The client asked who wrote our pitch. Will you tell her I copied it, or protect our partnership?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll withdraw it. Will you keep my name out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing doesn't answer her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then before you say yes, decide whether we're still partners when she puts down the phone.

mechanism: A treats withdrawal and confession as separate professional steps to pressure B into choosing partnership over a truthful client answer.
confusable: Defending a cover story asks agreement; D130 requires the relational cost of honest disclosure to be explicit.
comparison: Business partnership and client liability differ from a sibling's private promise.
seedUse: Use copied pitch and proposed joint withdrawal; make A correct the content of B's remedial offer.
